_about: Hand-made PONY guns. A unique is saved as its id plus the gun it stands for; core/gun_gen.gd rebuilds it from this file and refuses any copy that differs. Every unique gets: the listed parts (all made by the gun's own maker, so the factory-perfect bonus applies), all seven stat rolls at the maximum, three buffs and two skills at full quality, and the `bonus` below on top. `drop_chance` = how often a pony-tier drop is one of these. All names and numbers are placeholders for the director.

little_hoof.name: Little Hoof
little_hoof.flavor: Small. Fast. Kicks like something ten times its size.

stampede.name: Stampede
stampede.flavor: You hear it before you see it. Then you stop hearing anything.

thoroughbred.name: Thoroughbred
thoroughbred.flavor: Bred for one thing. It was never second.

clydesdale.name: Clydesdale
clydesdale.flavor: Pulls the whole fight behind it and does not notice the weight.

dark_horse.name: Dark Horse
dark_horse.flavor: Nobody bet on it. Nobody saw the shot either.

buckaroo.name: Buckaroo
buckaroo.flavor: Two barrels. Both of them throw you.

carousel.name: Carousel
carousel.flavor: Round and round it goes. Where it lands, everybody knows.

rodeo_clown.name: Rodeo Clown
rodeo_clown.flavor: Its whole job is to make the angry thing look the other way.
